title: fix(ui): stop retaining settled session snapshot keys
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: visiting distinct chat sessions leaves snapshot invalidation keys retained for the lifetime of the Control UI.

## User Impact

Long-running Control UI sessions release completed snapshot-read bookkeeping while preserving cached transcripts and stale-result rejection. No storage format or operator action changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

The retention census found that the revision map grew from 50 to 100 session keys across two blocks of navigation. Shared read identities now live only while reads and queued writes need them, and each operation releases its claim in `finally`. Same-key writes, deletion, scope invalidation, and global invalidation still retire old claims immediately. Queued writes retain their claims through settlement.

The existing sidebar persistence helper moves behind the same late snapshot-store import boundary to keep the owner within its file limit. The early database/prewarm graph remains unchanged.

## Evidence

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Snapshot owner tests | 44 passed; includes concurrent readers, invalidation/recapture, and queued-write churn |
| Prefetch and lifecycle tests | 34 passed |
| Sidebar persistence tests | 13 passed |
| UI typecheck, targeted lint, formatting/diff check | Passed |
| Isolated Codex review | Complete; no P0–P2 findings |
| Production UI build | Passed |
| Exact-base startup/route comparison | Strict check passed; startup 270,099 → 270,050 B gzip; Chat 1,225,588 → 1,224,878 B; requests unchanged |
| Production Knip | Passed |
| Retained snapshot-map keys after 50 / 100 switches | Base: 51 / 101 including the draft key; head: 0 / 0 |
| Broad UI/browser/real-Gateway proof | Requested through `ci:full` |

Snapshot tests use the repository's existing Node routing for their V8 garbage-collection proof; other focused tests use the default pinned Bun runtime. The census uses production bundles and synthetic Gateway data. This change has no visual effect.

Production LOC: 1,260 → 1,315 (+55). Snapshot test LOC: 642 → 732 (+90). No new timers, dependency, schema, or cache limits.

The exact-base census used `3f199f0208d` and this PR’s production renderer. Both builds retained 5,658 DOM nodes and 14,089 live Solid owners after 50 and 100 switches, preserving the pane cache. At 100 switches, total post-GC heaps were 50,511,812 / 50,597,012 B; this is a metadata-lifetime fix, not a claimed aggregate-heap reduction. Heap snapshots isolate the released map entries. Startup CSS stayed 40,097 B gzip in one request. The pre-existing total raw CSS budget excess is unchanged.
